rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis applies mechanical loading to induce segregation, while the target uses thermal aging to drive ordering and phase boundary evolution. These are fundamentally different kinds of intervention.
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis uses high strain rate and low temperature mechanical testing, whereas the target uses isothermal aging at 550-750°C. These are completely different regimes.
rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis invokes stress-induced solute segregation and brittle intermetallic precipitation at grain boundaries, while the target involves L12 ordering, APBE increase, restricted cross-slip, and stress concentration at jagged phase boundaries. These are different mechanisms.
rationale.outcome_agreement: The hypothesis predicts decreased toughness with brittle intergranular fracture, while the target predicts a non-monotonic ductile-brittle-ductile transition with minimum ductility at 600°C and recovery at 750°C. The predicted property direction and pattern differ.
